_doc: City goals (THPS 2 style; src/sim/game/goals.ts, docs/mechanics/goals.md): always on, in free skate and every game, in the worlds listed in parks. Each completes once per session (event goalComplete); the client keeps completion across sessions. Kinds: gap (any of gaps, ids in data/gaps.json), skitch (towed at least meters in one skitch; robo: a robotaxi), speed (at least kmh inside box [minX, minY, maxX, maxY], within z [min, max] if given), combo (a combo of at least points, started inside box; with gaps, it must hold one of them), collect (burritos collected this session), courier (deliveries in one courier game), bomb (finish the Hill Bomb, its route or the default: maxSeconds total, noBrakes without the foot brake or a powerslide, noFalls, win: first home ahead of the racers).

goals.name: Ollie an EV
goals.description: Any car is an EV if you squint. Ollie clean over one, roof to road.

goals.name: Robotaxi Hop
goals.description: Clear a robotaxi. It will log the incident and ask how your ride was.

goals.name: Skitch a Robotaxi
goals.description: Get towed 12 m by a robotaxi before it pulls over and files a complaint.

goals.name: The Long Way Home
goals.description: Skitch 200 m behind a human driver. They are honking because they care.

goals.name: Faster Than the F
goals.description: Hit 35 km/h on Market St. The historic streetcar does 25 on a good day.

goals.name: Dolores at 50
goals.description: Hit 50 km/h on Dolores St. Your mom does not need to know.

goals.name: No Brakes on Dolores
goals.description: Finish the Hill Bomb without touching your brakes: no foot brake, no powerslide.

goals.name: Hill Bomb Under 12
goals.description: Finish the Hill Bomb in under 12 seconds, penalties included.

goals.name: Grind the Mission Ledge
goals.description: Grind the curb in front of Fog City Skate Shop on Valencia. The shop is watching.

goals.name: Bench Press
goals.description: Grind a bench. Somebody was going to eat a sandwich there.

goals.name: Muni Hop
goals.description: Ollie over the J-Church tracks. It is not coming anyway.

goals.name: Park Rat
goals.description: Land a 5,000-point combo started in the skatepark.

goals.name: Dolores Park Show-off
goals.description: Land a 1,500-point combo started in Dolores Park, in front of everyone.

goals.name: Burrito Completionist
goals.description: Collect all 12 burritos in one session. You will need a nap.

goals.name: Gig Economy
goals.description: Deliver 5 orders in one courier shift. Tips not included.

goals.name: Twin Peaks Under 110
goals.description: Grand View to Castro in under 110 seconds, penalties included. The F-line takes twenty minutes.

goals.name: Twin Peaks at 56
goals.description: Hit 56 km/h coming down Upper Market. The fog cannot keep up.

goals.name: No Brakes on Twin Peaks
goals.description: Grand View to Castro without the foot brake or a powerslide. Trust the curve at 19th.

goals.name: Clayton Crest
goals.description: Catch air off the crest at Market and Clayton.

goals.name: Ollie the BART Stairs
goals.description: Off the top of the 16th St BART stairs, clear a dozen or more in one ollie. There are 49; the rest are for walking.

goals.name: Grind a Handrail at Harvey Milk Plaza
goals.description: Respect the plaza. Mind the Muni riders.

goals.name: Bench Grind Combo at Dolores Park
goals.description: A 2,500-point combo with a seat wall or bench grind in it, started at the planters by 19th. Mind the picnic blankets.

goals.name: Roof Grind a Hybrid
goals.description: Every parked car is a hybrid if you squint. Boneless up from the street and 50-50 a roof edge.

goals.name: Wallride a Mural in Clarion Alley
goals.description: Don't touch the paint, it is someone's life's work.

goals.name: Hayes Under a Minute
goals.description: Alamo Square to Octavia in under 60 seconds, penalties included. The tour bus takes twenty minutes.

goals.name: Beat the Landlord
goals.description: Win the Hayes St bomb. The Painted Ladies landlord owns three of them and will tell you about it.

goals.name: Turntable Rim
goals.description: Ollie across the edge of a cable car turntable without touching the timber. Powell and Market has the crowd; Hyde and Beach has the view.

goals.name: Hyde St at 50
goals.description: Hit 50 km/h down Hyde. The cable car does 15 and has better brakes than you.

goals.name: Grind a Lombard Flower Bed
goals.description: The crookedest street in the world has eight flower beds. Grind the wall round one. The hydrangeas have seen worse.

goals.name: Through the Dragon Gate
goals.description: Ollie through the Dragon Gate's middle opening on Grant. Mind the pillars; they were here first.

goals.name: Grind the Promenade
goals.description: Grind one of the granite edges along the promenade in front of Pier 7. The joggers will reroute.

goals.name: DIY or Die
goals.description: Grind the bank's edge at the DIY spot under the Central Freeway. Somebody mixed that concrete in a bucket. Respect.

goals.name: Hard Hat Area
goals.description: Grind the flat bar at a building site. The foreman is on his lunch break. The foreman is always on his lunch break.

goals.name: Lunch Break
goals.description: Grind a granite ledge in one of the plazas: Market Courtyard, Hallidie, Marini or 24th St. The office workers eating salads judge in silence.

goals.name: Hallidie Handrail
goals.description: Grind a handrail down Hallidie Plaza's steps. The cable car line is long; you have time.

goals.name: Potrero del Sol Line
goals.description: A 2,000-point combo with a ledge or the rail at Potrero del Sol in it, started in the park. The locals have been watching since 2007.

goals.name: The Roof by Duboce Park
goals.description: Up the pallets and the dumpster, or the stair, and grind the low roof's edge. The N Judah honks its approval.
